correctness.rationale: The nilpotent-cone classification is proved over finite fields via an explicit integral coordinate and a direct triangular criterion; all centralizers are checked from the derivative bracket. Ordered Heisenberg tuples reduce to rank-at-most-one 2-by-r matrices, followed by an exact recurrence for all lengths and its correct m=0 boundary. A standalone F5 checker exhaustively confirms 3125 derivations, 625 nilpotents, all centralizer sizes, and counts C2=6625, C3=108625; experiments corroborate but do not prove the general theorem.
